lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The mid-anterior flank displays a series of high-intensity circular nodes arranged in approximately four irregular vertical columns, with node size decreasing and density increasing towards the posterior flank and ventral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible, intersecting with the primary columns of large circular nodes to form a discernible grid-like pattern in the region posterior to the pectoral fin insertion.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is present along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal side and shadow-casting on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density concentration of small, high-luminance nodes is visible on the leading edge of the pectoral fin and across the cranial-dorsal surface.
